Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
MENSTRUAL REGULATION SYRINGE 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1. Scope— Dimensional and otiier requirements for menstrual regulation syringe of 50 cm^ (ml) 
capacity. 

2- Nomenclature — For the purpose of this standard, nomenclature given in Fig, 1 shall apply. 



p. 

o. 




-PINCH COCK 



SECTION XX 



-BARREL 



PISTON LOCK 



PISTON ROD 




LOCKING ARRANGEMENT 
PISTON -1 "^OR PISTON ROD HANDLE- 

FIG. 1 MENSTRUAL REGULATION SYRINGE TYPICAL 

3. Material 

3.1 3yr/>?5'e — Natural colour, translucent virgin grade polypropylene for the body, piston rod and 
piston. The washer for leakproofness provided on the piston shall be made of natural or synthetic 
rubber or combination of both suitably compounded or vulcanized, 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The syringe shall have good finish and smooth operation. 

4.2 The locking of the piston with the piston rod shall be rigid, 

4.3 The piston and rubber cover shall securely adhere to the piston rod. 

4.4 The syringe shall have positive stop for preventing the piston and the piston rod being pulled 
out completely. 

4.5 The button of the pinch cock shall be securely fixed. The pinch cock shall give leak proof lock- 
ing when pressed in position. 

4.6 The locking arrangement of the piston rod shall get engaged automatically when the piston is 
pulled out to maximum position, 

5. Performance — The syringe shall be capable of giving a vacuum of 86*5 KN/m^ ( 650 mm of Hg 
approx ) up to an altitude of 200 m above sea level. 

6. Instructions ~ The syringe shall be supplied with instructions sheet giving the following: 

a) 'Complete instructions for use, 

b) Instructions for cleaning, and 

c) The cautionary note worded as under: 

* Warning — Do not depress the syringe piston with the cannula in uterus. ' 



Adopted 17 Wlay 1977 



August 1977, ISI 




INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG

18:8459*1977 

7. Marking — Syringe shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade- 
mark and graduations in cm^ (ml ), 

7.1 ISI Certification Marliing — Details available with the Indian Standards institution. 

8. Packing — The syringe shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier 
and supplied with suitable lubricant inert to plastic. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

.This instrument is for use by trained surgeon only. It is expected that the performing surgeon 
is well versed with the procedure for menstrual regulation. The total responsibility for any procedure 
using this apparatus is that of the surgeon.
